arxiv-2003-11286.title: Computing the Theoretical Cost of the Optimal Ate Pairing on Elliptic Curves with Embedding Degrees 54 and 48 at the 256 256 -bits security level
arxiv-2003-11286.creator: Narcisse Bang Mbiang, Emmanuel Fouotsa, Celestin Lele
arxiv-2003-11286.description: Abstract Efficient computation of pairings with Miller algorithm has recently received a great attention due to many applications in cryptography. In this work, we give formulae for the optimal Ate pairing in terms of elliptic nets associated to twisted Barreto-Naehrig (BN) curve, Barreto-Lynn-Scott(BLS) curves and Kachisa-Schaefer-Scott(KSS) curves considered at the 128, 192 and 256-bit security levels.

arxiv-2111-11022.title: On the systemic nature of global inflation, its association with equity markets and financial portfolio implications Journal: Physica A
arxiv-2111-11022.creator: Nick James, Kevin Chin
arxiv-2111-11022.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nick James, Kevin Chin. This paper uses new and recently introduced mathematical techniques to undertake a data-driven study on the systemic nature of global inflation. We start by investigating country CPI inflation over the past 70 years. There, we highlight the systemic nature of global inflation with a judicious application of eigenvalue analysis and determine which countries exhibit most "centrality" with an inner-product based optimization method.

arxiv-2212-00446.title: Nontrivial lower bounds for the p p -adic valuations of some type of rational numbers
arxiv-2212-00446.creator: Bakir FARHI
arxiv-2212-00446.description: Abstract In this paper, we will show that the p p -adic valuation (where p p is a given prime number) of some type of rational numbers is unusually large. This generalizes the very recent results by the author and by A. Dubickas, which are both related to the special case p = 2 p=2 .

arxiv-2304-14094.title: Categorical Foundation of Explainable AI: A Unifying Theory
arxiv-2304-14094.creator: Pietro Barbiero, Stefano Fioravanti, Francesco Giannini, Alberto Tonda, Pietro Lió, Elena Di Lavore
arxiv-2304-14094.description: Abstract Explainable AI (XAI) aims to address the human need for safe and reliable AI systems. However, numerous surveys emphasize the absence of a sound mathematical formalization of key XAI notions—remarkably including the term “ explanation ” which still lacks a precise definition.

arxiv-2403-20138.title: Na Vacancy Driven Phase Transformation and Fast Ion Conduction in W-doped Na 3 SbS 4 from Machine Learning Force Fields
arxiv-2403-20138.creator: Johan Klarbring, Aron Walsh
arxiv-2403-20138.description: Abstract Solid-state sodium batteries require effective electrolytes that conduct at room temperature. The Na 3 ​ PnCh 4 \text{Na}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{3}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{3}}\text{}}\text{PnCh}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{4}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{4}}\text{}} (Pn = P, Sb; Ch = S, Se) family have been studied for their high Na ion conductivity. arxiv-2406-03240.title: Generalized Source Tracing: Detecting Novel Audio Deepfake Algorithm with Real Emphasis and Fake Dispersion Strategy
arxiv-2406-03240.creator: Yuankun Xie, Ruibo Fu, Zhengqi Wen, Zhiyong Wang, Xiaopeng Wang, Haonnan Cheng, Long Ye, Jianhua Tao
arxiv-2406-03240.description: Abstract With the proliferation of deepfake audio, there is an urgent need to investigate their attribution. Current source tracing methods can effectively distinguish in-distribution (ID) categories. However, the rapid evolution of deepfake algorithms poses a critical challenge in the accurate identification of out-of-distribution (OOD) novel deepfake algorithms.

arxiv-2410-18186.title: Precise predictions for the QCD axion contribution to dark radiation with full phase-space evolution
arxiv-2410-18186.creator: Marcin Badziak, Maxim Laletin
arxiv-2410-18186.description: Abstract We compute the QCD axion contribution to the energy density of dark radiation, parameterized by Δ ​ N eff \Delta N_{\rm eff} , by solving Boltzmann equations for the momentum distribution functions including the effects of quantum statistics for all particles involved in the axion production processes.

arxiv-2501-13236.title: Time-Constrained Model Predictive Control for Autonomous Satellite Rendezvous, Proximity Operations, and Docking
arxiv-2501-13236.creator: Alexander Soderlund, Sean Phillips, Evan Kain
arxiv-2501-13236.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Soderlund, Sean Phillips, Evan Kain. This paper presents a time-constrained model predictive control strategy for the six degree-of-freedom autonomous rendezvous, proximity, operations and docking problem between a controllable “deputy” satellite and an uncontrolled “chief” satellite. The objective is to achieve a docking configuration defined by both the translational and attitudinal states of the deputy relative to the chief, whose dynamics are respectively governed by both the Clohessy-Wiltshire equations and Euler’s second law of motion.

arxiv-2508-00718.title: Democratizing Tabular Data Access with an Open‑Source Synthetic‑Data SDK
arxiv-2508-00718.creator: Ivona Krchova, Mariana Vargas Vieyra, Mario Scriminaci, Andrey Sidorenko
arxiv-2508-00718.description: Abstract Machine learning development critically depends on access to high-quality data. However, increasing restrictions due to privacy, proprietary interests, and ethical concerns have created significant barriers to data accessibility. Synthetic data offers a viable solution by enabling safe, broad data usage without compromising sensitive information.

pmc-10558304.title: Intramuscular deep forearm hemangioma aggravated by a traumatic event: A case report
pmc-10558304.creator: Hussain Muhammed, Doried Diri, Hakam Alasaad, Sedra Abou Ali Mhana, Jaber Ibrahim
pmc-10558304.description: IntroductionHemangioma is a unique benign vascular tumor. Intramuscular seated lesions tend to cause pain, swelling, and disability in adulthood, especially after a traumatic aggravating event.Presentation of caseA young, healthy female suffered a previous trauma to her left forearm. Persistent pain developed after it with intermediate swelling that turned out to be a deep-seated hemangioma, which was treated successfully with excision.

pmc-10739066.title: Wearable Biosensing to Predict Imminent Aggressive Behavior in Psychiatric Inpatient Youths With Autism
pmc-10739066.creator: Tales Imbiriba, Ahmet Demirkaya, Ashutosh Singh, Deniz Erdogmus, Matthew S. Goodwin
pmc-10739066.description: This prognostic study investigates the use of wearable biosensors and machine learning for predicting aggressive behaviors in youths with autism who are psychiatric inpatients. Introduction Autism is one of the most common childhood disorders (occurring in 1 in 36 children).

pmc-11287515.title: Risk factors and clinical significance of posterior slip of the proximal vertebral body after lower lumbar fusion
pmc-11287515.creator: Jia-Jun Zhu, Yi Wang, Jun Zheng, Sheng-Yang Du, Lei Cao, Yu-Ming Yang, Qing-Xi Zhang, Ding-Ding Xie
pmc-11287515.description: BACKGROUNDAdjacent segment disease (ASD) after fusion surgery is frequently manifests as a cranial segment instability, disc herniation, spinal canal stenosis, spondylolisthesis or retrolisthesis. The risk factors and mechanisms of ASD have been widely discussed but never clearly defined.AIMTo investigate the risk factors and clinical significance of retrograde movement of the proximal vertebral body after lower lumbar fusion.

pmc-11459150.title: Self-locking and stiffening deployable tubular structures
pmc-11459150.creator: Ting-Uei Lee, Hongjia Lu, Jiaming Ma, Ngoc San Ha, Joseph M. Gattas, Yi Min Xie
pmc-11459150.description: SignificanceOrigami-inspired mechanisms can transform flexible sheets into lightweight and efficient structures. Inspired by curved-crease origami, here, we design a deployable tubular structure featuring geometric self-locking and stiffening effects using simple shell components. This tube challenges the fundamental trade-off between expandability and load-bearing capacity in deployable structures.

pmc-12853634.title: Intramedullary and extramedullary tibial alignment guides applied to each knee of the same patient resulted in no significant differences in radiological or clinical outcomes
pmc-12853634.creator: Seung Joon Rhee, Kyeong Baek Kim, Won Chul Shin, Seung Hun Woo, Min Uk Do, Eun Sung Lee, Sang-Min Lee
pmc-12853634.description: BackgroundThe superiority of intramedullary versus extramedullary alignment guides in total knee arthroplasty remains controversial, with previous studies reporting inconsistent results. Unlike studies comparing different patient groups, this study controlled for inter-patient variables by applying each method to the left and right knees of the same patients.

pmc-13085548.title: Isolation of Huangpi tick virus 1 and assessment of potential zoonotic relevance
pmc-13085548.creator: Liyan Fu, Chenxuan Li, Jun Ni, Jin Qian, Jian Xiao, Qiong Zhu, Shouwei Huang, Jinfeng Xiong, Qi Chen, Xuhua Guan, Rui Fang, Du Fen, Shuang Tang, Fei Deng, Dan Liu, Shu Shen, Xiaoli Wu
pmc-13085548.description: BackgroundThe global burden of tick-borne viral diseases (TBVDs) has significantly increased in recent decades, emerging as a critical public health priority due to their diverse pathogenic profiles, severe disease outcomes, and therapeutic challenges. Within the expanding landscape of tick-borne pathogens, the Orthonairovirus genus has gained particular scientific attention for its members’ zoonotic capacity and clinical virulence.

pmc-13178389.creator: Ying-Ying Deng, Zhi-Yong Li, Shi-Lin Chen, Zhi-Dong Qiu, Pu-Xuan Lu
pmc-13178389.description: with the longest documented history (5 years), which was successfully diagnosed using computed tomography (CT) after being initially misdiagnosed as cholangiocarcinoma on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The foreign body and its migration pathway were clearly depicted on CT with three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction, were confirmed by laparoscopy.

pmc-13393591.title: A case of anterior cranial fossa dural arteriovenous fistula concomitant with moyamoya disease
pmc-13393591.creator: Junki Youda, Tatsuya Shimizu, Ryousuke Shintoku, Masanori Aihara, Masahiko Tosaka, Soichi Oya
pmc-13393591.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Moyamoya disease is rarely complicated by other cerebrovascular diseases. A man in his 60s presented with subcortical hemorrhage in the left frontal lobe with an anterior cranial fossa dural arteriovenous fistula (dAVF) and concomitant asymptomatic moyamoya disease. Although the anterior cranial fossa dAVF and moyamoya disease have similar vascular architectures of intra and extracranial vascular connections via the ethmoidal artery, the former involves anastomoses between arteries and veins and the latter involves anastomoses between arteries.

pmc-13528160.title: Bridging preclinical development and clinical manufacturing: a translational GMP-Platform for lentiviral vector production in academic CAR T-Cell therapy
pmc-13528160.creator: Maribel Lara-Chica, Blanca Arribas-Arribas, Raquel Muñoz-García, María Dolores de la Rosa-Garrido, Miguel A Montiel-Aguilera, María Bermejo-González, Esteban Márquez-Pérez, Paola Hernández-Díaz, Beatriz Guijarro-Albaladejo, Belén Sierro-Martínez, José Antonio Pérez-Simón, Gloria Carmona-Sánchez, Est
pmc-13528160.description: BackgroundThe manufacturing of lentiviral vectors (LV) under Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) remains a critical bottleneck limiting the clinical translation of academic CAR T-cell therapies. To address this challenge, we established and validated an integrated GMP facility (ViPro-IBiS-UPRC) for aseptic LV production within a public healthcare setting.

pmc-13722528.title: Evolution of the Australian Institute of Sport Supplement Program over the last 25 Years
pmc-13722528.creator: Louise M. Burke, Gregory R. Cox, Ben Desbrow, Michelle Minehan, Aimee Morabito, Greg Shaw, Gary J. Slater
pmc-13722528.description: The Australian Institute of Sport Sports Supplement Program, launched in 2000, promotes evidence-based, safe, and legal supplement use in Australian high-performance sports. It has evolved into a comprehensive framework in response to regulatory changes, rapid growth in supplement products, and widespread access to both information and misinformation.
